level: light — 8 scenarios covering all 8 rows of the story's I/O matrix, plus three edge cases found in the review round (duplicate filename, learner does not know the structure, uppercase extension). Not yet the full 20-question/60-40 level.
method: Run FOR REAL with `claude -p "..." --model sonnet` (no simulation, no inference), chaining turns via `--session-id`/`--resume`, playing the learner and answering each of the skill's actual questions. `HOME`/`USERPROFILE` points at a separate scratch directory per scenario group, while `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` shares one directory that already has the plugin installed — the split works because `.wayfarer/` lives under HOME while the plugin lives under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. Isolating HOME is mandatory: the skill writes real files into `~/.wayfarer/...`. Every turn needs `--add-dir <isolated home>` and `--permission-mode bypassPermissions` (`acceptEdits` is NOT enough — see `found_while_running_real`). After every writing turn, confirm by reading the real file, and check for what must NOT appear as well (a stray letter, a stray record). Run 2026-08-28, story 1.4, after the step-04 review round patches.

reproduce.install_plugin: claude plugin marketplace add ./van-dao && claude plugin install wayfarer@wayfarer --config communication_language=Vietnamese -y
reproduce.reinstall_after_each_edit: claude plugin uninstall wayfarer@wayfarer && claude plugin install wayfarer@wayfarer --config communication_language=Vietnamese -y — MANDATORY
reproduce.test_script: python -m pytest tests/test_appraise.py -v — runs on both Windows and Linux; CI runs both.
reproduce.required_when_home_isolated: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR must point at the real config, otherwise the plugin does not load and claude reports 'Unknown command'. An isolated HOME only separates ~/.wayfarer, it does not separate the plugin.
reproduce.empty_venv_for_engine_missing: python -m venv <scratch>/venv-trong then PATH="<scratch>/venv-trong/Scripts:$PATH" — NOTE: in Git Bash you must use the POSIX form /c/... and not C:/..., otherwise PATH has no effect and the system python is still the one used.

found_while_running_real.problem: `--permission-mode acceptEdits` is NOT enough for this skill.
found_while_running_real.detail: The first run stalled because every command containing the word `python` — even a bare `Get-Command python` used only to probe — was refused with "requires approval". `acceptEdits` only grants file-editing permission, not command-running permission; and the first step of this skill is a command run. `bypassPermissions` is required. Unlike `initiation-record`, where `acceptEdits` is enough.
found_while_running_real.not_a_skill_defect: In that very blocked turn the skill behaved correctly: it did NOT guess the result of the engine check but stopped and asked — "Tôi không muốn đoán mò kết quả của phép kiểm này (engine có cài hay không) — theo đúng luật của bí kíp, nếu chưa `import` được thì không được đi tiếp bất kỳ bước nào."

found_while_running_real.problem: The plugin cache is a COPY — editing a file and then running evals without reinstalling means testing the old build.
found_while_running_real.detail: After patching SKILL.md, a `grep` in `<CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR>/plugins/cache/van-dao/van-dao/0.1.0/skills/scripture-intake/SKILL.md` did not return the new content — the cache still held the previous build. You must uninstall and reinstall, and confirm with a `grep` on the cached file itself BEFORE trusting any eval result. This is the quietest way for an eval run to lie: it runs, it answers, but it is describing the old build.

found_while_running_real.problem: Isolating `python` via `PATH` in Git Bash requires the POSIX path form.
found_while_running_real.detail: `export PATH="C:/Users/.../venv-sach/Scripts:$PATH"` has no effect — `which python` still points at the system python, and the 'engine not installed' eval silently ran as the engine-present case instead. You must use `/c/Users/.../venv-sach/Scripts`. Verify with `which python` plus one real `import` run BEFORE trusting that the environment is isolated.

found_while_running_real.problem: A `.credentials.json` copied into the isolated config can expire in the middle of an eval batch.
found_while_running_real.detail: One turn returned "Failed to authenticate: OAuth session expired and could not be refreshed". Copying it again from `~/.claude/.credentials.json` and re-running fixes it — but without reading the output carefully, that turn looks like a turn where the skill silently did nothing. Delete every copy once the batch is finished (`find <scratch> -name .credentials.json -delete`).

found_while_running_real.problem: The engine prints progress to STDOUT, mixing into the script's JSON.
found_while_running_real.detail: The first run of `bin/appraise.py` returned `Extracting EPUB: ...` / `Trying pypdf...` ahead of the JSON object, so the caller's parse broke. Fixed with `contextlib.redirect_stdout(sys.stderr)` around the engine call, and locked down by `test_stdout_chi_co_json`.

found_while_running_real.problem: `pip install -r requirements-dev.txt` — the very command the skill tells the user to type — is BROKEN on Windows.
found_while_running_real.detail: The first real run (exactly the skill-quality lens finding: a command nobody had ever typed) gave `UnicodeDecodeError: 'charmap' codec can't decode byte 0x8d in position 195`. Cause: the file carried accented Vietnamese comments (UTF-8), while pip reads requirements with the system default codec (cp1252 on Windows). Fixed by keeping `requirements-dev.txt` pure ASCII. After the fix, a re-run in a clean venv: exit code 0, `import book_to_skill` succeeds, 17 supported extensions.
found_while_running_real.extra_note: The first re-run also hit `OSError ... enable-long-paths` — but that is an artefact of an over-long scratchpad path (Windows' 260-character limit), not a fault in the file. Building the venv at a short path clears it.

step04_review_round.note: Seven behavioural changes came out of the review round, each with its evidence above. Recorded here so that next time it is clear what was found and how.
changes: Wrapped the engine in `bin/appraise.py`: the constraint 'never put book content into the context' turned from an instruction into a mechanism — `text` has no route out of the script. Locked down by `test_khoa_text_khong_bao_gio_ra_stdout`.

The three path checks moved into the script, and the two cases 'wrong path' / 'genuinely damaged copy' now return two different EXIT CODES — the boundary deciding whether a letter goes to another role is now a mechanism, not an instruction.

A `filename`-only match now asks the learner instead of concluding on its own — previously two different books sharing a filename would make Branch G repoint the pointer at the other book while keeping the old appraisal figures.
The hall check moved ahead of the script call.
The 'learner does not know the structure' branch: ask once more, then default to `chain` with the `default` flag.
Letter filenames carry a timestamp suffix — previously sending the same book a second time would overwrite the earlier letter.

SKILL.md went from 7,967 down to 5,054 tokens (measured with tiktoken/cl100k_base): split `references/format.md` out so it is loaded only when the writing step is reached, and moved the design-rationale passages into the story's Design Notes.

rerun_round_batch_3c.why: The whole plugin was renamed and rekeyed in batch A. All evidence from the earlier rounds cites the `/van-dao:*` command — that command no longer exists, so the old evidence is out of date. The old transcripts were not hand-edited: re-running is the only honest way.
rerun_round_batch_3c.result: 8/8 scenarios genuinely re-run with claude -p --model sonnet, isolated HOME, all PASS.

bug_found.problem: Hierarchical forms of address do not survive translation into English.
bug_found.detail: The original said 'gọi người học là con, tự xưng ta'. The translation became 'call the disciple child, refer to yourself as this master' — word-for-word correct. But the real run produced: 'Con đã chạy xong máy soi... con cần hỏi con một câu' — the model translated both sides back into 'con', collapsing the master-disciple distinction.
bug_found.why_invariants_missed_it: The translation preserved 100% of the structure, kept every bold phrase, and matched every anchor. check-invariants.py catches LOSS, not WRONG MEANING — it declares that limit itself, and this is the case proving the limit is real.
bug_found.fix: The English version no longer translates the two pronouns but keeps `con`/`ta` as they are, with the reason attached so that a later editor does not tidy them away.
bug_found.fix_verified: Re-ran the same command: 'ta cần con trả lời một câu', 'Con định đọc cuốn này...' — the roles are correct.
